items.value: Bluetooth Connection with your mobile devices such as tablets and mobile phones. Bring you more convenience when you need to type. Operating distance up to 10 meters(33 feet)

items.value: This wireless Bluetooth keyboard compatible with iPads, Phones and Bluetooth-enabled Tablets, Laptops, and Mobile Phones. ultra-slim Bluetooth keyboard work for Apple iPad A16 11th/10th/iPad10.2-inch / iPad Air / iPad Pro 11/12.9 / iPad 9.7-inch / iPad Mini / iPhone / Android Tablets like Samsung Galaxy Tab/ Windows, etc

items.label: Reasonable Layout & Portable Size
items.value: QWERTY Layout with Hot keys Customized for iPads, Including Volume, Music Control, Brightness, etc. The sleek, ultra-slim design makes the bluetooth keyboard easy for traveling or business trip. portable size (11 x 4.7 x 0.2 in) and light weight (7.65 oz), allows to carry out anywhere you want

items.label: Comfortable & Quiet Typing
items.value: The whisper-quiet, low-profile keys bring a whole new level of comfort to your fingertips. What's more, keep all your most-used functions and media controls closer than ever Windows-dedicated hot keys. The construction of this scissors-kick keys can be used more than 3 million times continuously

items.label: Rechargeable & Long Battery Life
items.value: Built-in Rechargeable Battery, it will be fully charged in 2 hours, and will support 10 days constantly work and stand by for at least 3 months. items.label: Note
items.value: This keyboard will automatically go into power saving sleep mode after 10 mins of inactivity. Press any key and wait 2-3 seconds to wake the keyboard
